chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 512 – Ji Ning Enters the Heartforge Tribulation – A Quiet Moment Before Immortality
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces the deadliest trial of his tribulation—the Heartforge. Will his Dao-heart hold? A short breather chapter sets the stage for a breakthrough.
og_title: Desolate Era – The Heartforge Tribulation Begins
og_description: The Wind, Fire, and Thunder have passed. Only the Heartforge remains—the final test of Dao-heart before Celestial Immortality.
twitter_description: Ji Ning is inside the Heartforge illusion. Tomorrow, we see if his Dao-heart can overcome the ultimate trial.

lore_anchors.definition: The fourth and most dangerous stage of the Heavenly Tribulation. It traps the cultivator in a perfect, personalized illusion world that tests the absolute sincerity of their Dao-heart; physical defenses are useless against it.
